exclusion_reason: Chrome can be observed live and another profile can be diagnosed as installed or absent, but no game-runtime package exists to test across the browser and device matrix.
promotion_trigger: Promote when FIX-023 passes every required browser profile or produces the predeclared blocked or degraded result with artifact.
expected_failing_assertion: BPTK has no package or support floor that can be verified across browser profile.
active_gate_evidence: The product observes Chrome live, diagnoses Safari and Firefox availability, and always refuses a compatibility claim without a package runtime.
procedure: Run the same package on the pinned Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, and selected mobile profile.
Capture browser, OS, architecture, GPU, feature, limit, header, input, storage, memory, artifact, and degradation result.
pass_criterion: Every required profile matches its declared supported, degraded, or blocked outcome.
No environment is labeled supported without a retained artifact.
